integrity: The central all-alphabet triangle enumeration is proved from an explicit established pair-edge lemma and a new interval-decomposition argument. Standalone finite verification is supporting evidence, not infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Counts three-vertex cliques of the at-least-two-common-single-deletion-descendant graph, not ordinary one-read confusability triangles, maximal cliques, or optimal codes. Uses the published Type-A pair theorem. An equivalent unindexed clique classification may imply the count; no independent mathematical audit has occurred.
title: Exact triangle spectrum of the two-read deletion-confusability graph
